rationale: Material cohort ownership evidence: task-scoped CodingCommands bundles and change_checks share existing fixed selectors and managed Commands; local closeout adds protected validation and feature-only authority; governed Integration independently owns destination tree/review/promotion. These are different claims, so do not merge them blindly into one validator or move orchestration into Runtime. Single-command evidence-name selection diverges from all-bundle/change-report reservation and has a distinct new P2 proposal rather than being hidden under this investigation. A small application-local receipt-allocation composition may be justified by those real consumers. Scripted review/validation fixtures prove wiring, not independent semantic review or model effectiveness. Existing large application/edit-size pressure and useful shared substrate remain open; no package split, new Agent or generic transaction system authorized.
duplicate_disposition: Original UUID retained; append-only evidence only. No approval, B-number, grant, closure or duplicate parent obligation.
